edges: Liz Lemon invites Rosemary Howard to be a guest writer on The Girlie Show.
Jack Donaghy fires Liz Lemon and Rosemary Howard after a disagreement.
Liz Lemon promises to send Rosemary Howard $400 a month for the rest of her life.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Jack Donaghy assures Tracy Jordan that he can do anything he wants as a movie star, except for dog fighting.
